title: Historical briefings cut off in the early 2010s

tellings.quote: there was an initiative in the early 2010s to cut off historical briefings on new on new program incumbents.

plain: In the early 2010s, according to an online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb, there was an effort to stop giving the history of secret UFO-related programmes to the new people taking them over. He tells Michels, passing on what he was told, that "there was an initiative in the early 2010s to cut off historical briefings" for new programme incumbents. If true, it would mean those newly in charge of such work were deliberately kept from knowing what came before.
